gaps.explanation: Missing fund columns: the governmental funds statement (pp6-7, printed p19) prints major fund columns 'Debt Service' (Total revenues 523,702 = Property 38,185 + Sales 477,650 + Interest income 7,867) and 'Aquatic Center' (610,351 = Sales 597,063 + Interest income 11,488 + Other income 1,800) with no schedule of their own; none of their lines are in detail. Added 1,134,053. Different basis for the rest: Capital Projects budget schedule p14 total resources 1,052,010 vs statement column 1,447,720 (-395,710: Grants and contributions 1,056,406 vs 1,452,116); Street budget schedule p13 1,073,879 vs statement 1,075,609 (-1,730: Sales tax 177,944 vs 179,119, Other 90 vs 645); Economic Development p15 113,486 vs statement 91,029 (+22,457: Loan collections 22,966, Sales tax 77,109 vs 77,618). Arithmetic: 7,417,919 + 1,134,053 = 8,551,972 = statement 8,926,955 - 374,983 (395,710 + 1,730 - 22,457). The remaining 374,983 is the budgetary-basis difference (printed totals differ), no fix for it.
